send.pay.body: Pay {amount} by iDEAL now and print the label at home, with how to stick it on. Then there is nothing to pay at the shop.
send.pay.orShop: Or pay at the shop, with the code above.
send.pay.testBody: This server pays with Mollie’s test money: no real money moves.

send.pay.paidBody: Print it and stick it on the parcel, or show it on your phone at the shop. Nothing more to pay there.
send.pay.printBlocked: Your browser blocked the print window: allow pop-ups for this page, or show the label at the shop.
send.pay.orShow: No printer? Show this label on your phone at the shop.
send.pay.printNote: Hand the parcel in at the shop you chose. Nothing more to pay there.
send.pay.step1: Stick the label on the largest flat side of the parcel.
send.pay.step2: Cover or remove any old labels and barcodes.
send.pay.step3: Tape all four edges of the label.
send.pay.step4: Do not fold the label over an edge of the box.
send.pay.step5: Keep the QR code clear: no tape across it and no marks on it.
send.cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
send.cancel.meansUnpaid: The booking ends and the place held at the shop is given back. Nothing was paid, so nothing comes back. To send it after all, book it again.
send.cancel.meansPaid: The booking ends and the place held at the shop is given back. What you paid online goes back in full to the account that paid; it can take a few working days to show.
